correctness.rationale: The geometric fixed set is PL homeomorphic to the invariant orbit-face complex. König and the bipartition give a six-original-vertex cutoff. Odd widths have the central middle-row fixed vertex as a cone vertex by exhaustive symbolic cases (r,f). Even widths give D3*(P3 square P_(h-1)) plus exactly three edges and seven triangles; three elementary edge-triangle cancellations leave four null-attached 2-cells, and the join supplies 4h-8 further two-spheres. The all-width proof is reconstructed in RESULT.md. An independent enumerator verifies orbit models and mod-two homology for 38 widths; finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete integral homotopy classification of geometric fixed-point spaces for an infinite three-row grid family at robustness parameter four, the first parameter beyond the source’s general theorem, shows a sharp parity transition and 2n-4 two-sphere multiplicity.
